summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on PR #279 at b8c9fe096c3591e43073b9d6c2aa6c50859f26b4. The added classified-count, assembly upper-bound, and envelope/part consistency checks are directionally correct, but the snapshot contract still accepts two states impossible for PhysicsLabValidation.captureInternal: zero Models despite the mandatory selected Model root, and nonzero BaseParts with zero assemblies despite capture inserting an assembly root (or the part itself) for every BasePart. Add models >= 1 and parts > 0 => assemblies >= 1 regressions before integration. The global pr-ownership checker import failure is unrelated and remains a separate merge gate.
evidence: src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabValidation.luau captureInternal asserts root:IsA('Model'), calls inspect(root), and inspect increments counts.models for that root.
The same capture loop inserts assemblyRoots[AssemblyRootPart or instance] for every BasePart, then counts every unique assembly root, so parts > 0 cannot produce assemblies == 0.
PR #279 inspectSnapshot currently checks only assemblies <= parts and instances >= 1; neither lower-bound relationship is enforced.
PR #279 issue comment 5249840177 records the actionable review feedback.
